ops.title: project: fix-the-primitive wave shipped end-to-end 2026-07-20 — cc-transcript primitives live via 14.4.0 ancestry (14.3.0 = burned tag, no wheel), capt-hook v10.6.0 = anti-workaround steering hooks + primitive adoption; hard lessons: commit-on-green in r
ops.body:
The 2026-07 fix-the-primitive wave is fully shipped on both ends. Upstream: cc-transcript's `OtherCall.error`/`FallbackCall.error`, `cc_transcript/synthetic.py` (+ `parser.parse_events`), and the parse-compositionality contract — tagged v14.3.0 but the wheel never published (monotonic-version gate; a concurrent session had released 14.4/14.5 mid-wave). **14.3.0 is a burned number: tag exists, never reuse or delete it; the primitives reach users via 14.4.0+ ancestry.** Consumer: capt-hook v10.6.0 (stack b28312b5..8764d86b) — the anti-workaround steering hook pair (steering 0.8.0: `upstream_workaround_edit` nudge + `upstream_workaround_turn` Stop-gate) plus `parse_degraded` reading `OtherCall.error`, `reason_kept` minting via `synthetic_user_event`, and the transcache contract cite. Repo-side detail lives in cc-notes (capt-hook note d0e1225, cc-transcript note 0f9cb9d).

**Why:** three durable lessons cost real work this wave.

**How to apply:**
- **Commit the moment gates pass, in a repo-resident worktree — never stage finished work uncommitted in /tmp.** A verified-green 8-file port died in a /tmp worktree when the machine rebooted (after an earlier process death had already killed one review pass); the redo was cheap only because the port report survived with every decision recorded. Extends [[shared-tree-build-lock-races]]'s "snapshot /tmp patch before waits".
- **`.claude/worktrees/` is a shared namespace — a concurrent session may adopt your worktree mid-wave.** The framework session started writing its Phase B work into my `ch-wave-wt` minutes after my commits landed there. Commits in the object store are safe; working trees are not. Verify `git status` cleanliness immediately before relying on any shared-repo worktree, and evacuate ship assembly to a fresh worktree if foreign hunks appear. Never `worktree remove` an entry that shows uncommitted changes you don't recognize.
- **A Signals prefilter with per-signal weight == threshold is an OR, not a conjunction** (window scope scores each signal once by presence). If the intent is "N distinct evidence families", set weights 1 and threshold N. Caught in review on the workaround Stop-gate; the fix also exposed that the workaround lexicon lacked temporariness tells ("for now", "in the meantime", "temporarily") — the single most characteristic workaround phrasing.

Related: the concurrent session's async-persistence migration (139f65d7, pin `>=14.6.1,<15`) superseded ~90% of this wave's original lane C mid-flight — [[cctranscript-1460-command-primitives-shipped]] tracks its still-pending Phase B consumption (cc-notes 4cba719).
